market_view: Calm regime (VIX 16.5, falling); June CPI and PPI came in soft, easing rate-hike worries, with the Fed meeting this week. Iran tensions are back and oil rebounded sharply.

oil_gas.reasoning: Iran war resumption lifted WTI +12.6% in 5 days, but that driver move is already priced; XOM itself reacted little and a Yahoo piece notes it did the opposite of war-trade instinct. No XOM-specific event.

gold_miners.reasoning: Soft CPI/PPI (Benzinga, SeekingAlpha) helped gold, but gold +1.6% yesterday and miners already bounced; Fed meeting adds variance, not direction. Analyst PT changes are not catalysts.

chips.reasoning: Nvidia CEO saying Rubin remains on track only rebuts delay reports; NVDA already +4% yesterday and +7.5% in 5 days. No export change, guidance raise or TSMC sales seen.

pharma.reasoning: Merck Keytruda trial and J&J beat-and-raise concern MRK and JNJ, not leader LLY. LLY fell 6.7% in 5 days with no explanation in the headlines; no LLY event.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Morgan Stanley PT lift on FCX and Truist Cameco initiation are analyst opinions; NJ nuclear plan relates to CCJ, not FCX. FCX +3.3% yesterday is priced.

would_change_my_mind: A named company event for the leader (guidance raise, regulatory approval, export-control change, confirmed supply outage) or a clear Fed-driven rate shift for gold.

handoff.what_changed: Iran war resumed and WTI rebounded about 12.6% in 5 days; June CPI and PPI were soft; J&J beat and raised; Nvidia said Rubin is on track; Merck Keytruda endometrial trial positive. No leader-specific catalyst, so all stay flat.

oil_gas.why: Oil rally from Iran news is a driver move already priced; no XOM-specific catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Soft inflation data helps but is already reflected; Fed meeting this week adds variance only.

chips.why: Rubin on-track comment is a rebuttal, NVDA already up strongly; no export or guidance catalyst.

pharma.why: News concerns MRK and JNJ, not the leader LLY.

copper_uranium.why: Only analyst target changes and thematic pieces for FCX.
